title: [bug] tauri v2  bundler treat `gnueabi` and `guneabihf` all as `armhf`

labels.name: status: needs triage
labels.description: This issue needs to triage, applied to new issues

body:
### Describe the bug

When producing .rpm or .deb packages in Tauri v2, the bundler incorrectly treats both gnueabi (soft-float) and gnueabihf (hard-float) targets as armhf. As a result, packages for both soft-float (armel) and hard-float (armhf) platforms are incorrectly generated as armhf, leading to potential runtime issues on devices that expect armel.

```
    Bundling Clash Nyanpasu_2.0.0-alpha+f2c306b_armhf.deb (/home/runner/work/clash-nyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/backend/target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release/bundle/deb/Clash Nyanpasu_2.0.0-alpha+f2c306b_armhf.deb)

```

There is the `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi` target bundle output:

```
Finished `release` profile [optimized] target(s) in 13m 33s
    Built application at: /home/runner/work/clash-nyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/backend/target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi/release/clash-nyanpasu

    Warn The bundler was configured to create updater artifacts but no updater-enabled targets were built. Please enable one of these targets: app, appimage, msi, nsis
    Warn Legacy v1 compatible updater is deprecated and will be removed in v3, change bundle > createUpdaterArtifacts to true when your users are updated to the version with v2 updater plugin
    Finished 2 bundles at:
        /home/runner/work/clash-nyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/backend/target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi/release/bundle/rpm/Clash Nyanpasu-2.0.0-alpha+f2c306b-1.armhfp.rpm
        /home/runner/work/clash-nyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/backend/target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi/release/bundle/deb/Clash Nyanpasu_2.0.0-alpha+f2c306b_armhf.deb
```

You could see the detailed build log at: https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/actions/runs/10821854546/

### Reproduction

I use prefabricated docker image via `cross-rs` to build cross targets.

First, we should create a `Cross.toml` with the content:
```toml
[target.aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu]
image = "ghcr.io/libnyanpasu/builder-ubuntu-22.04-aarch64:latest"

[target.armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf]
image = "ghcr.io/libnyanpasu/builder-ubuntu-22.04-armhf:latest"

[target.armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi]
image = "ghcr.io/libnyanpasu/builder-debian-trixie-armel:latest"

[target.i686-unknown-linux-gnu]
image = "ghcr.io/libnyanpasu/builder-debian-trixie-i686:latest"

```

Then, build the target `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf`:
```shell
pnpm tauri build -r cross --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf -b "rpm,deb,updater"
```

And, build the target `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi`:
```shell
pnpm tauri build -r cross --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi -b "rpm,deb,updater"
```

### Expected behavior

The `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi` target should produce the `armel` bundled pkgs.
And, the `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf` target shoudl produce the `armhf` bundled pkgs.
